name: autologin-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants Windows auto-admin-logon (the classic cleartext DefaultPassword finding) via the Winlogon registry values. Vars: USERNAME (required); PASSWORD (required); DOMAIN (optional, defaults to the machine). Idempotent.
script:
if (-not $USERNAME -or -not $PASSWORD) { throw 'USERNAME and PASSWORD are required' }
$k = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine.OpenSubKey('SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon', $true)
$k.SetValue('AutoAdminLogon', '1', 'String')
$k.SetValue('DefaultUserName', $USERNAME, 'String')
$k.SetValue('DefaultPassword', $PASSWORD, 'String')
if ($DOMAIN) { $k.SetValue('DefaultDomainName', $DOMAIN, 'String') }
$k.Close()
